observations.evidence: A normal white-light command failed with an empty GATT service table. Subsequent BlueZ diagnostics contained the mesh proxy service and both required characteristics. A later connection succeeded without lamp reboot or device removal.
Third command returned HTTP 500. Integration logged a nonempty but incomplete service table lacking the mesh proxy characteristics. Test stopped and restored Adaptive Lighting manual_control=false.

observations.revision: local validated-cache and incomplete-table retry patch
observations.evidence: Installed files still match tested checksums. Two-hour live test completed: 14 repeated commands, reconnect after 15 minutes idle, approximately 83 minutes of Adaptive Lighting, and a final explicit command. No test failures or Oasis operation errors were recorded. All 237 availability observations were on. Adaptive Lighting manual control was restored to false and another automatic update succeeded after completion.

limitations: Home Assistant light state is optimistic; service success does not prove physical illumination.
Bluetooth logged an ENOMEM management-socket error during a transient host stall. Later available host memory was approximately 1.5 GB; whole-host RAM exhaustion is not established.
No factory reset, mesh key change, sequence rollback, or BlueZ device removal was performed.

unit_test_matrix.platform: macOS arm64; Home Assistant API doubles

host_runtime_observation.event: Bluetooth management socket ENOMEM while loading connection parameters
host_runtime_observation.correlated_events: DNS timeouts across multiple unrelated integrations and Zigbee watchdog warning within seconds
host_runtime_observation.lamp_result: Adaptive Lighting continued changing lamp temperature; no Oasis operation failure logged at the subsequent check
host_runtime_observation.interpretation: Host resource/event-loop pressure is plausible; whole-host memory exhaustion and the precise cause are not proven. Do not describe this run as free of Bluetooth log errors.
host_runtime_observation.subsequent_result: No further Bluetooth log errors through the final check at approximately 20:45 UTC. Lamp operation continued and the sustained test completed successfully.

physical_confirmation.result: Lamp is visibly on and behaving normally
physical_confirmation.timing: Confirmed after the completed two-hour run

errors: Mixed RGB and white temperature command rejected
GATT INVALID_HANDLE during start_notify, before mesh writes
recurrence.subsequent_state: Lamp unavailable; absent from Pi live scanner and BlueZ object list although historical advertisement remains
recurrence.conclusion: The earlier two-hour run passed but did not establish lasting reliability. PR returned to draft pending further repair.

followup_patch.status: installed; user power cycle restored discovery; standard Home Assistant brightness controls pass; lasting reliability remains unproven
followup_patch.behavior: Retry notification setup once with fresh discovery for ATT invalid-handle or database-out-of-sync errors, before sequence allocation and mesh writes. Other failures and writes are not replayed. Log conflicting RGB/white request values for diagnosis.

post_power_cycle_validation.result: Commands succeeded; lamp on at brightness 255 and 2700 K; Adaptive Lighting manual control cleared after testing
post_power_cycle_validation.errors: No new Bluetooth or mixed-color errors; one 0.631-second state update warning
post_power_cycle_validation.limitations: The new stale-handle retry has not been observed recovering a live failure. Original mixed-color request path remains unresolved. Power cycling restored discovery but does not establish why advertising stopped.
